title: Thinking of making an AI chatbot NPC game, does this sound like a fun concept?
author: kjiezl_
selftext:
hey everyone!

So I'm planning a small practice game and I want to experiment with AI powered NPC chats. Basically, characters you can actually chat with instead of just reading fixed dialogue.

One idea I have is a “guess the liar” mechanic, where only one NPC is lying about something (like “who stole my cookie?”) and the others tell the truth. Players would have to figure out who’s lying based on talking to everyone.

I'm still figuring out the gameplay loop, because just walking around and chatting might get boring.

To keep the AI on-topic and in-character, I plan to feed the models structured prompts for each NPC. I’m also thinking of using open-source AI models so I can experiment without worrying about cost.

Does this sound like a fun concept? Still figuring out how to make this more enjoyable to play

comments.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
comments.body: Guessing if an AI is lying is about as fun as flipping a coin no?
